cdn.sub: The slug is the component name lower-cased with nothing between the words — <c>HuggingFace</c> is <c>huggingface</c> — and variants carry a suffix: <c>-color</c>, <c>-text</c>, <c>-brand</c>. PNG and WebP sit under a <c>light</c> or <c>dark</c> directory, which is what a <c>picture</c> element needs to follow the reader's colour scheme.
cdn.title: Every mark is also a file

css.note: Monochrome marks are drawn in <c>currentColor</c> and sized by a single prop, so they take the colour of the text around them and stay sharp at any size — they are vectors, not sprites.
css.title: Sized and coloured like text

files.note: Every mark is also a file on a CDN. No install, no build step — an <c>img</c> tag is enough, and PNG and WebP ship light and dark renders for a <c>picture</c> element to choose between.
files.title: Or skip the install entirely

lookup.note: A model id from an API response is a string, not an import. <c>ProviderIcon</c>, <c>ModelIcon</c> and <c>AgentIcon</c> map it to a mark through a keyword table, with a neutral fallback when nothing matches.
lookup.title: Resolve a mark from a string

features.sub: Four things the package does so an application does not have to keep its own folder of logo files.
features.title: Built to be consumed, not vendored

treeshake.note: The build emits one module per brand, so a bundler drops the {{count}} you did not name. A bundle-size budget in CI guards it — this is the regression that stays invisible until someone reads their bundle report.
treeshake.title: Import one brand, ship one brand

footer.tagline: Brand marks belong to their respective owners and are used here to identify them. This package is a fork of lobehub/lobe-icons, MIT licensed, and keeps that licence.

hero.sub: Logos for AI providers, models and applications as typed React components — colour, wordmark, lockup and avatar variants — plus static SVG, PNG and WebP on a CDN.
hero.title: Every AI brand,

install.peers: <c>react</c>, <c>react-dom</c> and <c>antd</c> are peer dependencies. The same build is published as <c>{{alias}}</c> at the same version — pick one, not both.
install.title: Add it to a project

variants.sub: A brand is rarely one drawing. Each one ships the marks it actually has, and the table of contents records which — so a gallery can render the right set without guessing.
variants.title: One brand, five ways to draw it
